flavor: The person you're supposed to meet is always somewhere in the docks district. Gather your party and venture forth!

title: Zombies!
flavor: A shambling mass of former humans lurches through the snow, drawn to the scent of your flesh. Can you hold them off?

title: Medieval Library
flavor: Bearded men hunch over scrolls and books, quills scratching quietly. Outside the weather turns slightly and no one notices. Shhh!

title: Monster Attack!
flavor: Panic! Offshore nuclear testing has resulted in  a wave of monster attacks throughout the city! Run for your lives!

title: Sleeping Dragon
flavor: Coiled and half buried on a towering mound of treasure, an ancient red dragon slumbers. You should probably let it be.

title: The Age of Steam
flavor: A long hiss from a massive locomotive blankets the platform in thick white mist while porters scurry about with baggage carts. "Tickets please!"

title: Forest: Night
flavor: Gentle breezes wafting through the trees overhead, the sounds of the night spill forth like jewels.

title: 1940's Office
flavor: "It ain't ritzy, and the pay is peanuts, but it's a decent place to get some shut-eye 'til knock-off time".

title: Asylum
flavor: You don't belong here... You don't know how you got here... There's been a mistake...Yeah, that's what everybody says.

title: Royal Salon
flavor: The Royal Salon, France, early 18th Century: a minefield of verbal sparring, whispered plots and social combat. Tread carefully

title: Dungeon I
flavor: You and your party creep along the twisting, torch-lit hallways of the abandoned mine. Pro tip: let the barbarian lead.

title: Mountain Pass
flavor: A treacherous path through towering mountain peaks is the only way through. Pray your supplies don't run out, and your party stays together.

title: Industrial Shipyard
flavor: Massive derricks heave containers from cargo ships overhead, while all manner of human activity occurs down below.

title: Middle Earth:Dawn
flavor: When not being overrun by filthy orcses, Middle Earth can be a beautiful place.

title: Orbital Platform
flavor: The massive viewports on this orbital platform allow for breathtaking views of this sectors' impressive stellar phenomena.

title: Dark and Stormy
flavor: "It was a dark and stormy night, the rain fell in torrents -- except at occasional intervals when it was checked by a violent gust of wind..." E. Bulwer-Lytton

title: Dinotopia
flavor: Across space and time, a verdant world has evolved without mankind. How can a planet be simultaneously peaceful and deadly?

title: Terror
flavor: There are doors you should not open. Places you should never see. Turn back... Now. Halloween 2014

title: Colosseum
flavor: Equal parts blood sport, theater and ritual murder. The Roman gladiators entertained the populace for over 600 years.

title: Medieval Town
flavor: Life inside the walls, where commerce, struggle and celebration mingle with honor, chaos and crime.

title: Ice Cavern
flavor: Soaring vaults of ice echo and groan, amplifying the freezing wind and hollow noises within.

title: Mountain Tavern
flavor: An oasis of warmth and hospitality in a harsh and unforgiving environment. Warm up in front of the fire, and share a mug of spiced wine.

title: Strangers on a Train
flavor: With its lush interiors, fine dining and finer passengers, the Orient Express was the most well-appointed overland transportation available.

title: Warehouse 13
flavor: An old cement factory on the outskirts of town. Power still works. Sort of. The perfect spot to disappear - or make things disappear.

title: Woodland Campsite
flavor: Every adventurer needs downtime. Here's a nice spot in the woods to rest the horses and enjoy a hot meal over a fire.

title: Super Hero
flavor: Like a Michael Bay movie in your head. Calling all heroes. The villainous tropes are on the loose!

title: Goblin's Cave
flavor: Journey up the winding path, follow the stream into the mouth of the cavern. Light your torches. Proceed...cautiously.

title: Overland with Oxen
flavor: Your party has assembled, your cart is loaded with supplies, your oxen are sturdy. Just keep your eyes peeled for trouble on the road.

title: There be Dragons
flavor: Wiping the last of the Kobold blood from your axe, you glare in the direction of the Cleric. "Enough of this nonsense, let's go get us a real fight!"

title: Cathedral
flavor: Cavernous, cold and quiet. Ethereal chants and muted footsteps. Paladins welcome.

title: Samurai HQ
flavor: Wealthy Japanese feudal lords used Samurai as their private armies. [2 Alternate versions available for Patreon Patrons]

title: Victorian London
flavor: London, 1851. Streets awash in noise - Merchants, organ grinders, Hansom cabs and the ever present din of humanity. Thank god for the rain.

title: Dome City Center
flavor: Amid the bustle of commerce, life under the dome runs smoothly. It almost makes one forget the hostile environment beyond.

title: Rise of the Ancients
flavor: “The oldest and strongest emotion of mankind is fear, and the oldest and strongest kind of fear is fear of the unknown”  - H.P. Lovecraft

title: Starship Bridge
flavor: The hum of engines, the vibrations of deck plates - as familiar to you as a childhood lullaby.  Order, duty and experience keeps ships in the sky.

title: The Long Rain
flavor: "It was a hard rain, a perpetual rain, a sweating and steaming rain; it was a mizzle, a downpour, a fountain . . ." - Ray Bradbury

title: Temple of the Eye
flavor: Hooded figures gather around a gleaming eye, smoke wriggles like serpents to the ceiling. What dark energies have these voices awakened?

title: Into the Deep
flavor: If the darkness, pressure and isolation don't get you, the shadows in the trench just might. This kind of work isn't for everyone.

title: Clash of Kings
flavor: Two great armies lumber toward each other like centipedes of metal, flesh and bone. The ensuing conflict fuels song, poetry and legend for centuries.

title: Down by the Sea
flavor: Vast expanses of sand, hypnotic surf and the cries of gulls on the wing. Now there's that small issue of getting off this island paradise alive...

title: Catacombs
flavor: Dimly lit and twisting. The passages lead deeper and deeper under the city. The skulls of heroes past look on with blank anticipation.

title: Los Vangeles 3030
flavor: Towering spires of glass, neon and steel - dense air traffic and a constant rain that never cleanses. (Apologies to the Greek.)

title: Swamplandia
flavor: Hot, humid and swarming with insects of every kind. You'd go around if you could, but you know the only path is through.

title: Far Above the World
flavor: "Here am I, floating round my tin can". Or if you prefer -  "That's funny. The damage doesn't look as bad from out here."

title: City and the City
flavor: Where else can you get a roll of toilet paper, a falafel and a bootleg DVD at 3am?

title: Frozen Wastes
flavor: Visibility and temperatures plummeting by the second, your only thought is survival. But in your heart you know - you've been through worse.

title: Uncommon Valor
flavor: Bullets buzz overhead like wasps defending a hive. One last look at the girl in the torn photo. Breathe deep, keep your head down. This is for freedom!

title: Xingu Nights
flavor: Dense, rich and verdant, the forest floor oozes with life and decay. Overhead, the canopy has hidden the sky for millennia.

title: Deep Space EVA
flavor: The deal was simple: 4 years working on a deep space mining operation and you could return to earth a free man. That is, if you survived.

title: Forbidden Galaxy!
flavor: Hurtle through the cosmos! Explore unknown worlds! Face fearsome foes from beyond! Set ray-guns to ADVENTURE!

title: The Slaughtered Ox
flavor: A horn of mead, a bowl of stew and a hook to hang your 50 feet of rope,  The Slaughtered Ox has been catering to the adventuring class for eons.

title: Derelict Freighter
flavor: The listing hulk of a derelict space craft makes a tempting salvage target. But what happened to her crew? Something is not quite right here.

title: True West
flavor: Sometimes having a price on your head isn't enough to keep you out of town. As long as there's whisky, cards, and the possibility of a payday.

title: Dark Continent
flavor: In another timeline, in another universe, it was the ancient city-states of Africa which eclipsed Rome as a beacon of civilization, culture . . . and war.

title: The Age of Sail
flavor: Fear not the mountainous waves and perilous winds! For who among us, will journey upon the sea and not gaze, ultimately, upon himself?

title: House on the Hill
flavor: You've heard the stories all your life. 50 years ago this night, an entire family killed after church one Sunday. Only one survived. 'The baby' still lives there.

title: Alien Night Club
flavor: It's hot, crowded, and swarming with species from every corner of the galaxy. The perfect spot to blend in, fade away or meet the perfect wingman.

title: Alien Machine Shop
flavor: You want the latest modifications? You want to squeeze a few more years out of those ancient matter displacers? It's gonna cost you.

title: Busy Space Port
flavor: The gleaming heart of any worthwhile planet. You can get transport here to just about any place.  It's a good spot to meet a pilot, a smuggler, or your next mark. Keep your head down.

title: Solemn Vow
flavor: When death is near, and retreat is not an option. Only the bravest have any purchase on the word "honor".

title: Abyssal Gaze
flavor: The blackness of space, the silence of the open sea, the depths of a cave. When you stare into the abyss...you know the rest.

title: The Desert Awaits
flavor: The air before you distorts in the heat. The sun has baked the world into an impenetrable crust. Nothing can survive out there for long. Yet out there is where you must go.

title: Dust to Dust
flavor: Sometimes the only sure thing is the end. Beyond the adventure, beyond the riches, beyond the fame. Everyone dies.

title: Before the Storm
flavor: Sharpen those swords, check the perimeter defences and pray to whatever gods you hold dear. Tomorrow's going to be a big day.

title: In the Shadows
flavor: This seemed like a pretty good place to hide, but now, you're not so sure. There's something familiar about this place. There's also something moving

title: Shelter from the Storm
flavor: Admittedly, it may not be the perfect spot. But it's a hell of a lot better than out there. At least it's warm and we'll get a chance to rest.

title: Disembodied Spirits
flavor: The night is alive with a thousand tiny voices. It's hard to make out what they're saying. Are they the welcoming committee? Or a warning klaxon.

title: Cave of Time
flavor: Deep underground an ancient cavern yawns before you and welcomes you, it's first visitors in a thousand years. The denizens of this place may not agree.

title: Protean Fields
flavor: A plane beyond your own, filled with darkening swirls of color and mist. A low, pulsing energy embraces your mind and dulls your thoughts.

title: The Inner Core
flavor: You're deep into it this time. The center of everything. The world around you thrums with energy and portent...

title: Bubbling Pools
flavor: The stench of life fills the air. Viscous fluid bubbles to the surface in great exhortations of gas and moisture. Something about these pools is familiar..

title: Desert Bazaar
flavor: Everything about this desert planet is familiar, but different at the same time. The pungent aroma of spice fills you with the thrill of adventure.

title: March of Faith
flavor: The devoted stream into the distance. The dust from their sandaled feet blocks out the sun for miles around. There's no stopping them. They believe.
